title: Awesome app + suggestion
body:
Awesome app well done. 
Suggestion - provide an option to cramp all 4 pages of items into one or two - increase the density. I have many items and I find it tiring to swipe between all pages. Up next view also does not do the job as well, as if I would have all items in one page.
author: wza360

title: Decreasing Screen Time
body: I just wish that Decreasing Screen Time habit could automatically sync with integrated Screen Time function on ios because it seems a bit inconvenient to start the timer on my own when I use the phone and stop the timer when I don’t. Overall perfect app.
author: gridush
